lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately 5-6 visible vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, with larger, more isolated centroids located posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a structured grid across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient where the dorsal edge of each ridge is brighter than the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a very high density of small, high-luminance circular spots that are significantly smaller and more concentrated than the pattern on the main body flank.
